text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I'm at my wit's end... What the 
heck am I supposed to do in this 
situation!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I stopped by the arcade, I 
ran into Tamamo Cross looking troubled.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Sorry, I'm in a huge pinch right now! 
Hate to ask, but could ya lend me a hand!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLATTER-RATTER-RATTER-RATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Status: 'Big Haul.' There is no sign of 
the medal payout stopping. Medal count 
increasing significantly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An absurd amount of medals was spilling 
out from the medal game machine in front 
of Mihono Bourbon. They spilled all over 
the floor and still showed no signs of 
stopping.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon! That's not goin' well at all! The 
machine's broken!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Good afternoon, Tamamo-san. However, I 
must reject that assumption. Something 
similar has happened before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Since two similar cases were confirmed, I 
judge this condition to be 'normal.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLATTER-RATTER-RATTER-RATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Status: 『Big Haul』. 『Big Haul』... 
Heart rate increase detected. Slight 
emotional state of 『Elation』 detected.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! That's no good! I'll go get a staff 
member! Trainer, keep watch right here!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ah!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! For a princess such as myself, 
clearing a racing game is child's play!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Kawakami-chan, that's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to blast right through, 
dearieeees! Heaaave-hooo!! Tuuurn, 
dammiiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Crack!*)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? The steering wheel has come 
right off, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami! Stop! Don't grip the steering 
wheel with that much force!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-chan, look! My screen has so many 
pretty, blinking red X marks!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Uraraaa! You're runnin' the wrong way!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no good...! My hands are full! There's 
no way I can handle all of this!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Are you in trouble, Tama-chan?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Creek!? Perfect timing! Trainer! The three 
of us are gonna break through this 
situation together!
choice_data_list: Then I'll take Kawakami and Urara!
Then I'll take Kawakami and Urara!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Creek!? Perfect timing! Trainer! The three 
of us are gonna break through this 
situation together!
choice_data_list: Then I'll take Kawakami and Urara!
Then I'll take Kawakami and Urara!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'll come along too! Creek, you 
take care of Kawakami and Urara!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Okaaay, have a safe trip~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Tamamo Cross, I called over 
a staff member, and the medal game was 
successfully fixed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I'm so sorry for 
causing you trouble.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No worries at all! I'm just really glad 
it's fixed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Now then, resuming 
Operation 'Medal Game.'

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait...!? Hold on...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I had to ask the shopkeeper to come 
over one more time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tama-chan, Trainer-san. Good work today~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'll come along too! Creek, you 
take care of Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Okaaay, have a safe trip~

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo-san! Trainer! Thank you so much! 
Thanks to you both, I was able to make it 
all the way to the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I managed to clear the game as well! By 
relaxing my shoulders, I was able to 
execute such elegant cornering!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see. I'm glad for you two. Just seeing 
those smiles makes me happy enough.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, Urara-san! One more time, 
reaching for speed beyond speed!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami & Urara
text_block_list.text: The race has started!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Did you forget to step on the gas this 
time around?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tama-chan, Trainer-san. Good work today~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You really saved me, Creek. And Trainer, 
you were in the right place at the right 
time. Thanks, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Not at all~. I was just on my way back 
from checking out the baby section 
myself~♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Baby supplies?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My family ran a daycare, so just looking 
at baby supplies makes me happy~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I saw some clothes that would look lovely 
on Tama-chan too~♪ ...Oh, I know! Let's 
head back together to the baby section 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Heeeelp meee!
